info.title: v2.logistics.update_operating_hours
info.description: This API is designed to allow sellers to update their operating hours. It is essential that the values provided in this API align with the restrictions retrieved from the v2.logistics.get_operating_hour_restrictions API to ensure compliance with platform requirements. This API uses overwriting updates, when updating pickup operating hours, still need to include all parts even those not needing changes.

post.description: This API is designed to allow sellers to update their operating hours. It is essential that the values provided in this API align with the restrictions retrieved from the v2.logistics.get_operating_hour_restrictions API to ensure compliance with platform requirements. This API uses overwriting updates, when updating pickup operating hours, still need to include all parts even those not needing changes.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date: it should be include all date from start_date until end_date

parameters.name: enable
parameters.description: To specify this value as False if you're not operate on that date (close)

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: The end date of the Special Operating Hours. The value should be within [start_date + 30 days]

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: End time for operating hours on that day: The time should be in the format XX:YY, where YY is either 00 or 30. Except for a 24-hour, you can input a start_time of 00:00 and an end_time of 23:59

parameters.name: friday
parameters.description: Operating hours for Friday: You can skip this information if you want to mark the day as closed.

parameters.name: instant_operating_hour
parameters.description: Details of Instant Operating Hours : You can skip this parameter if you are not creating/updating Instant Operating Hours or if you do not have access to create/update Instant Operating Hours

parameters.name: monday

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of Special Operating Hours

parameters.name: operating_hours
parameters.description: To specify the operating hours for each date

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: public_holiday
parameters.description: Operating hours for public holiday: You can skip this information if you want to mark the day as closed.

parameters.name: regular_operating_hour
parameters.description: Details of Pickup Operating Hours / Preferred Pickup Hours: You can skip this parameter if you are not updating the Pickup Operating Hours / Preferred Pickup Hours

parameters.name: saturday

parameters.name: shop_collection_operating_hour
parameters.description: Details of Shop Collection Operating Hours : You can skip this parameter if you are not creating/updating Shop Collection Operating Hours or if you do not have access to create/update Shop Collection Operating Hours

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2
